description: Save a filter under a name (or change one of yours: pass id). Required: entity, name, filter. shared=true makes it visible to everyone in the tenant (e.g. as a recipient list).

filter.description: Filter definition as in search_crm: { all: [conditions], any: [conditions] }

id.description: ID of one of your saved filters to change; omit to create a new one

shared.description: Make the filter visible to everyone in the tenant

name: save_filter
